culturalBackground: Royal mehndi draws on motifs from Mughal art and architecture, such as domes, arches and formal floral panels.
Designs often show a bride and groom, a palanquin (doli) or elephants in a wedding procession.
The style uses dense coverage and is mainly chosen for bridal mehndi.
Arched window frames, known as jharokha, are often used to frame the figures.
applicationTips: Sketch the main figures first and build the borders around them.
Book an experienced artist for portrait work; faces are the hardest part of this style.
Allow several hours for both hands and feet.

faqPool.a: It is a bridal style with Mughal-inspired architecture, formal florals and figures such as the bride, groom and a wedding procession.

faqPool.q: Is royal mehndi suitable for guests?
faqPool.a: It is usually reserved for the bride. Guests tend to choose lighter designs.

faqPool.q: How long does a royal bridal design take?
faqPool.a: Expect several hours for both hands, and longer if the feet are included.
